title: Camera Scan Action Schema
description: CameraScanAction parameter definitions. Referenced by custom.action.schema.json.

wait_nodes.title: Wait Nodes
wait_nodes.description: Recognition nodes checked before and after every camera movement except reset; success if any hits.

aim_target.title: Aim Target
aim_target.description: After a recognition hits, swipe from the screen center to the hit box center before returning success. Defaults to false.

move_up.title: Move Up Node
move_up.description: Pipeline node for one upward camera step. Defaults to __CameraScanMoveUp.

move_down.title: Move Down Node
move_down.description: Pipeline node for one downward camera step. Defaults to __CameraScanMoveDown.

move_left.title: Move Left Node
move_left.description: Pipeline node for one leftward camera step. Defaults to __CameraScanMoveLeft.

move_right.title: Move Right Node
move_right.description: Pipeline node for one rightward camera step. Defaults to __CameraScanMoveRight.

fallback_yaw_steps.title: Fallback Yaw Steps
fallback_yaw_steps.description: Discrete horizontal movements in each fallback ring. Defaults to 8.
